name: doorman
description: Get past a sign-in wall. When a page redirects to a login, returns 401 or 403, or renders signed-out, doorman replays a browser session the developer signed in for once — so pages behind a login stop being a dead end for browser automation. Works with forms login, OAuth/OIDC, SAML and enterprise SSO; no password or MFA prompt is ever automated or stored.

interface.shortDescription: Get past a sign-in wall for browser automation.
